basics.name: Zadkiel AHARONIAN
basics.label: Developer · Platform & Reliability · Open Source
basics.summary: I'm a **developer** who builds and runs **platforms**, drawn to two problems: reliability you can sleep through, and platforms other engineers actually want to use. I've run Kubernetes at scale from public and sovereign clouds through on-prem to the edge, but I'm proudest of the open source I build and maintain, and the **1,000+ PRs I've merged upstream**. Right now I'm exploring how agentic AI changes the way platforms get built.

work.name: Airbus Aircraft
work.summary: Cloud-native and edge platforms for next-generation onboard aircraft systems.
highlights: Delivered 5+ MVPs for next-generation onboard platforms, from concept to production-ready.
Designed Kubernetes foundations for onboard application management and rollout-constrained environments.
Built Varnish-based onboard video/content distribution and **Jetson/GPU real-time computer-vision** pipelines.
Built an AWS landing zone (Control Tower, AFT) with self-service account vending, and designed its dev-to-prod security gates.

work.name: CCL Consulting
work.summary: Kubernetes platform engineering and DevOps consulting in a multi-client service center, across public and sovereign clouds.
highlights: Led development of a **self-service Kubernetes platform product** and Go-based CLI to bootstrap clusters and application stacks from declarative config, with GitOps delivery, layered Helm/Kustomize composition, secret hydration and repeatable local/cloud/bare-metal environments.
Developed a **Kubernetes compliance engine** for real-time security and best-practice visibility across developers, compliance teams and operators.
Delivering platform maintenance and enhancements across client environments using immutable infrastructure, GitOps workflows and modern security practices to 10+ client teams.

work.name: Carrefour
work.summary: Internal Kubernetes platform team for Carrefour product teams, operating shared clusters and platform services across GKE, Rancher RKE, Azure IaaS/Kubespray and AKS.
highlights: Operated and modernized 10+ Kubernetes clusters across multiple clouds, up to 200 nodes each, serving 50 product teams.
Led **RKE to AKS migration** with GitOps, immutable infrastructure and security guardrails, delivering high availability and zero-downtime cluster upgrades.
Built self-service Kubernetes platform capabilities, **GreenIT** resource-efficiency practices, runbooks, alert tuning and active on-call incident response.
Developed and contributed to Kubernetes controllers/operators for multi-tenancy, logging and platform automation.
